notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
Added :

- New locations
- New tasks
- Unusual interactions and puzzles
- Plot twist and game ending
- Localizations: English, German, French, Russian

Improvements :

- Reworked and improved locations
- New sounds 
- Animated actions
- New decor and lore items
- New enemy behavior mechanics
- Optimization

Fixed bugs :

- Fixed bugs with saving the game
- Fixed bugs with localization
- Fixed minor decorative bugs in the game
